card: Keep the changing weeks of pregnancy together.
title: PregnancyPal week by week
intro: PregnancyPal keeps week-by-week information and personal entries together during pregnancy. It gives a place for the details you want to remember.

sections.heading: What is PregnancyPal for?
sections.body: It is a companion for the changing weeks of pregnancy.

sections.heading: What can you follow each week?
sections.body: Week-by-week information includes nutrition and exercise.

sections.heading: What can you write down?
sections.body: You can keep vitals, symptoms, mood and appointments in the same record.

sections.heading: Where does PregnancyPal fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps life stages among the seven areas around you. PregnancyPal concentrates on the weeks of pregnancy and the details you choose to record there.
